name: presentation.help
summary: Search the presentation JS API and template catalog.

name: presentation.getActiveSlide
summary: Return the currently active slide when one exists.

examples.code:
const slide = presentation.getActiveSlide() ?? presentation.slides.add();
slide.shapes.add({ geometry: 'rect', position: { left: 40, top: 40, width: 240, height: 80 } });

name: presentation.record
summary: Capture the patch generated by a JS API edit block.

name: presentation.comments.addThread
summary: Attach a comment thread to a slide, element, or text range.

name: slide.autoLayout
summary: Lay out a list of shapes inside the current slide.

name: slide.shapes
summary: Shape collection for creating and retrieving slide shapes.
notes: Use slide.shapes.add(...) to create shapes and shape.delete() to remove one shape.
Use slide.shapes.deleteAll() to clear all shapes from the slide.

name: slide.shapes.add
summary: Add a preset/custom/connector shape to a slide.
notes: Preset geometry values include rect, roundRect, ellipse, triangle, rightArrow, and many other PowerPoint shape names.
Use slide.shapes.connect(...) for attached connectors. Direct geometry: 'connector' adds require from/to endpoint shapes and connection site indexes.

name: slide.shapes.getItem
summary: Get a shape by name or by { id }.

name: slide.shapes.deleteAll
summary: Delete every shape on the slide.

examples.summary: Clear a slide before rebuilding it

name: shape.delete
summary: Delete this shape from its slide.
